fields.summary_ko.0: Philippe Laffont of Coatue Management opened a new position in SK Hynix (SKHY) in Q3, betting on AI memory chip supply shortage.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix achieved record Q3 revenue of KRW 104.62 trillion, up 328% year-over-year, with operating profit of KRW 83.33 trillion surging more than sevenfold.
